from.place: the clause identifying quasi-isomorphisms with acyclic mapping cones in the hypotheses of Situation 05S8

title: A morphism is a quasi-isomorphism exactly when its mapping cone is acyclic
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. For a morphism $f:K\to L$ of cochain complexes indexed by $\mathbf Z$ in the homotopy-category setup [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], $f$ is a quasi-isomorphism if and only if the mapping cone of $f$ is acyclic.
